## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/console",
  "type": "ConsoleOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/console').par.data` (an input). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.data`.
